title: First and Second Conditionals
description: Real plans or imaginary situations? Complete each sentence with the right verb form.

thumbnail.alt: A small cloud with rain on one side and a dreamy thought bubble with a guitar on the other

items.text: If it [[rains]] tomorrow, we'll stay inside and watch a movie.
If I [[had]] more free time, I would learn to play the guitar.
She [[will]] call you if she finishes work early.
items.hint: First conditional: will + verb in the result.

items.text: If we [[lived]] near the beach, we would go swimming every day.
items.hint: Second conditional: past simple after if.

items.text: If you [[don't|do not]] hurry, you'll miss the bus.
items.hint: First conditional: present simple after if.

items.text: What [[would]] you do if you found a wallet on the street?
If I were you, I [[would talk]] to the teacher about it.
We [[won't|will not]] go to the park if it's too cold.
